verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms https://docs.stripe.com/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with agent-directed instructions. Issuing pages are served as clean markdown (e.g. issuing.md returns HTTP 200), and Stripe's official MCP server lets agents search its knowledge base. Together these let an agent be pointed directly at agent-oriented docs. Missing for 10: independent or community corroboration of agents using these docs in practice, and confirmation that llms.txt indexes the Issuing-specific pages.
